comment: The review state of every server, read by scripts/sign_catalog.py and scripts/ci_results.py. Only servers whose shipped MCP server code we reviewed completely ourselves, for backdoors and bad code, are signed for sandbox-ai; a server not reviewed, or changed since its review, stays pending in the signed catalog. files: SHA-256 of what decides the image (Dockerfile, requirements*.txt, src/) at the review; after reviewing a change: scripts/sign_catalog.py --record-review NAME. Marking a server reviewed is an edit of this file together with its record (docs/SIGNING.md).
